script:
Everyone uploading PDFs to Claude is basically wasting all their tokens and Microsoft has a free fix.
So every time you upload a PDF, Claude has to process the entire thing, the formatting, the broken tables, the images, and all the extra junk inside the file.
Each PDF page can consume between fifteen hundred to three thousand tokens, so a twenty page document can burn up to seventy thousand tokens in one shot.
And that's before you even ask a single question.
So the fix is simple.
It's called MarkItDown, a free Microsoft tool with over a hundred and ten thousand stars on GitHub.
It takes almost any file, PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, PowerPoints, or even YouTube videos and converts them into clean Markdown text.
So this can reduce your token usage by up to seventy percent, and Claude can give better answers because Markdown is a format AI models understand extremely well.
Plus, MarkItDown comes with an MCP server.
That means when you connect it to Claude Desktop, it can automatically convert any file you upload to a .md file.
If you want the link and full guide, just follow and comment X.
